title: Microcontroller LED and Button
description: The classic first project: a button input and an LED output on a development board.

education.summary: The board supplies power; the MCU pin sources current for the LED through a resistor, and reads the button against a pull-up.
objectives: Connect an LED to a GPIO pin safely
troubleshooting: LED always on: check the pin is an output and the resistor value
Button reads randomly: the pull-up is missing
